decision_rationale: The paper presents a pretrained foundation model plus a fine-tuned read classifier, but the model description is encoder-only and predictive rather than generative. It still shows foundation-model-like pretraining and broad read embedding use.
evidence_snippet: "REMME is an encoder-only transformer model" and "a pretrained foundation model REMME"; "fine-tuned model for enzymatic function annotation, classifying reads into seven first-level EC classes"
